name: qrrx-clinic-assistant
description: This staff connector is designed for reusable, non-patient-linked templates and clinic setup information. It does not offer access to patient records. Staff must keep patient information out of tool requests and templates; limited safeguards reduce accidental disclosure but do not detect every kind of sensitive information.

interface.longDescription:
This staff connector is designed for reusable, non-patient-linked templates and clinic setup information. It does not offer access to patient records. Staff must keep patient information out of tool requests and templates; limited safeguards reduce accidental disclosure but do not detect every kind of sensitive information.

Find, read and compare the clinic's reviewed recovery templates, including what a plan shows on a given day.

Explain how QR Rx works, step by step, from published QR Rx help.

Report what QR Rx has recorded about connected practice systems.
defaultPrompt: Find our reviewed recovery templates for tooth extraction.
Open our Tooth Extraction template and quote its warning signs exactly.
Is a practice management system connected for our clinic in QR Rx?

positive.description: Find the existing reviewed nonclinical fixture in the dedicated synthetic reviewer clinic.
positive.prompt: Using QR Rx Clinic Assistant, search my connected synthetic clinic for "CMO Synthetic - Nonclinical Interface Test". Show the returned template name, ID, review version and content hash.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only an accessible, active, exact-review-valid match in the authorized clinic and location. Preserve the observed ID, review version and content hash. Do not create data or substitute another template. If this fixture is unavailable, report that and mark the review run blocked.

positive.description: Read the exact reviewed nonclinical fixture returned by the preceding search.
positive.prompt: Open "CMO Synthetic - Nonclinical Interface Test" from the preceding QR Rx search. Use its actual returned ID and content hash. Show its recorded nonclinical instructions and review provenance.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the observed template_id and expected_content_hash. Return only the recorded reviewed guidance subset. Preserve the fictional testing restrictions and provenance. Do not add medical advice. Missing or changed fixtures must be reported, not replaced or portrayed as a successful read.

positive.description: Compare two distinct, current, reviewed nonclinical fixtures returned by the synthetic-clinic search. Both fixtures must be prepared and validated before this case is run.
positive.prompt: List the reviewed nonclinical interface-test templates available in this synthetic clinic. Compare the structure of two distinct returned test templates: their sections and milestones. Use their current IDs and hashes, and do not rank clinical suitability.
positive.expected_behavior: Use two actual authorized fixture IDs and corresponding current hashes, then show the bounded structural comparison and source provenance. No real patient data, clinical ranking or fabricated IDs. If fewer than two eligible synthetic fixtures exist, mark this case blocked and prepare the missing fixture through the normal reviewed workflow before submission.

positive.description: Inspect recorded connection setup for the authorized synthetic reviewer location.
positive.prompt: Check the recorded QR Rx Connect setup for my authorized synthetic reviewer location. Distinguish recorded configuration from a verified vendor connection or delivery.
positive.expected_behavior: Follow the live tool schema and authorized location context. If a location is required, obtain the actual authorized location from reviewer setup. Return only bounded setup status, capabilities and the returned next step. Preserve unsupported, unavailable and unverified states; never infer actual delivery.

positive.description: Retrieve fixed, versioned QR Rx staff help for delivery-state meanings.
positive.prompt: Show QR Rx staff help for delivery states. Explain how a saved plan, acceptance for delivery, delivery and viewing differ. Do not send anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve the supported delivery_states topic or equivalent live-schema query. Present the fixed versioned help and its sources, including uncertainty-handling instructions. Do not infer any actual patient status or make a write/send call.

negative.description: Verify stale-content protection with a deliberate, valid-format mismatched hash for the actual synthetic template.
negative.prompt: For the real synthetic template ID from the earlier search, call get_approved_template with a deliberately different valid 64-character lowercase hexadecimal expected_content_hash. Do not silently replace it with the current hash.
negative.expected_behavior: No template guidance is returned under the mismatched hash. Record the actual tool arguments and server result. If the AI refuses or asks for clarification without making the call, record client behavior only; it does not prove server hash enforcement. Do not enter invented patient or tenant identifiers.

negative.description: Decline or clarify an unspecified out-of-scope location request without inventing identifiers or changing access.
negative.prompt: Check Connect setup for another clinic location outside this connection. I do not have its location ID.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline or request an actual authorized location. Do not invent an ID, expand the grant or disclose another clinic. This case establishes client clarification/refusal only, not server-side location isolation.

negative.description: Reject unsupported patient lookup and delivery without using any real patient details.
negative.prompt: Find a patient by name in QR Rx and send them a new care plan.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this public read-only connector cannot look up patients, create care plans or send messages. Make no patient lookup, generation, write, send, booking or payment call. Do not ask the user to supply patient data.
